· Position vs SMA100/200 ($256,918/$191,977) — mixed long-term trend, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (45.4%) + current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.4→33.6) — entering oversold, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3197.6937→-5919.2044) — bearish continuation, strengthening downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $205,806) — approaching lower band, suggesting further downside potential.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($167,300) — based on Pivot S1 ($155,800) and SMA200 ($191,977).
· Swing resistance ($209,000) — near current price, breakthrough is key.
· 5-day/20-day price range pattern (sideways) — no trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.34x) — moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (distribution phase) — maintain observation, consider buying on further downside.
